# runtime/third_party/stb

`stb_image.h` v2.30 from [nothings/stb](https://github.com/nothings/stb) @ 048d2aa5 (MIT or public domain, chosen by
the user: both texts at the end of the file), unchanged. `ui/launcher/mods_browse.cpp` includes it with
